Fixtures in this directory are responses from the Statistics Norway (SSB)
StatBank API, retrieved 2026-11-23, licensed CC BY 4.0
(https://www.ssb.no/en/diverse/lisens). Source: Statistics Norway.

- `14020_new_private_cars_2026-11.json`: table 14020, new private cars by fuel
  group, 1995M01-2026M10 (json-stat2), unmodified.
- `jsonstat_small.json`: hand-written json-stat2 document in the same shape,
  for parser and revision tests (not SSB data).
